units: <cite ref="Niddah 49b:7">Nidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>היה טוֹרֵד וכ׳</he> if the liquid drips drop after drop.
Bekh. 44ᵃ (עיניו) טוֹרְדוֹת running eyes (more than דלף); [Ar.: restless, constantly twinkling; oth. opin.: shutting with great trouble, v. infra).
<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 14:5">Tosef. Yeb. XIV, 5</cite> <he>שמא גל טורד אותו וכ׳</he> (v. ed. Zuck. note) perhaps a wave carries and lands him.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 14:5">Ib.</cite> <he>טְרָדַנִי גל לחבירו</he> one wave carried me to the other; (Y. ib. XVI, 15ᵈ top <he>טרפני</he>).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 21</cite> <he>טְרָדָהּ חוץ וכ׳</he> he sent her out of the palace.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite> (play on <he>מ̇הי̇טב̇אל בת מט̇ר̇ד̇</he>) <he>שהיו מט̇יב̇ין … ואח״כ טו̇רְדִין וכ׳</he> they dressed her for her husband and then led her away from her husband.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:14">Kidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>וטוֹרְדוֹ מן העולם</he> and drives him (his father) out of the world (makes him desperate).
Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXI, beg. וט׳ אותם מן העולם and drove them into despair, a. fr.—3) to weary, make unsteady.
Snh. 22ᵇ; Erub. 64ᵇ דרך טוֹרְדָתוֹ (Taan. 17ᵇ מַטְרִידָתוֹ Hif., Ms. M. everywhere מַטְרַחְתּוֹ, v. טָרַח) walking makes him unsteady (feel the wine).
Nidd. 25ᵃ, sq. מים … וטוֹרְדִין וכ׳ water is strong (is in commotion) and stirs the mass up, opp. מצחצחו makes it clear.—Part. pass. טָרוּד, f. טְרוּדָה; pl. טְרוּדִים, דִין …, טְרוּדוֹת

senses.gloss: busily engaged, troubled, anxious. Gen. R. l. c. (play on מטרד, v. supra) ט׳ היו וכ׳ they were anxious for a living.
